purpose: Reconstruct and correct the unsupported full-text-verification claims appended on 2026-07-15 under a 2026-07-14 heading.

scope.reason_translation_not_required: Both sources and all accessed text are in English.

sources.citation: De Baere S et al. Development of a HPLC-UV method for the quantitative determination of four short-chain fatty acids and lactic acid produced by intestinal bacteria during in vitro fermentation. J Pharm Biomed Anal. 2013;80:107-115.
Gu B-C et al. Rapid Electrochemical Profiling of Fecal Short-Chain Fatty Acids Using Esterification/Dissociation Fingerprints and Artificial Neural Networks. Biosensors. 2026;16(4):223.
sources.location_basis: NCBI PMC full text, article sections, tables, and supplement index

claims.value: Bacterial culture supernatants; four short-chain fatty acids plus lactic acid.
claims.supporting_paraphrase: The method measures four SCFAs and lactic acid produced during in-vitro fermentation and was used to screen bacterial-culture supernatants.
claims.oe_boundary: Does not establish transfer to an Open Enzyme strain, medium, or operator workflow.

claims.value: 210 nm; the abstract characterizes this wavelength as short and non-selective because the analytes lack a significant chromophore.
claims.supporting_paraphrase: Detection was performed at 210 nm, making chromatographic separation and matrix controls load-bearing.
claims.oe_boundary: Published detection chemistry, not OE matrix selectivity.

claims.value: Liquid-liquid back extraction with diethyl ether; samples acidified below pH 2 before HPLC-UV analysis.
claims.supporting_paraphrase: The final preparation used ether back-extraction and acidification below pH 2 before separation on a Hypersil Gold aQ column.
claims.oe_boundary: Recovery and interference remain untested in the intended OE culture matrix.

claims.supporting_paraphrase: Matrix-matched calibration covered 0.5-50 mM; reported correlation and goodness-of-fit coefficients fell within the recorded ranges.
claims.oe_boundary: A published calibration range is not an OE acceptance criterion.

claims.supporting_paraphrase: The abstract reports analyte-spanning LOD and LOQ ranges; it does not assign a specific value to butyrate in the accessible text.
claims.oe_boundary: Do not present the range endpoints as butyrate-specific without the full article.

claims.supporting_paraphrase: The abstract describes direct 210-nm detection and its extraction workflow but does not explicitly use the term underivatized or state that no derivatization step exists.
claims.oe_boundary: Use the exact preparation and detection description instead of the unsupported shorthand.

claims.value: VBS-100 portable workstation and disposable G3 screen-printed electrodes with a gold working electrode, carbon counter electrode, and on-chip Ag/AgCl reference electrode.
claims.supporting_paraphrase: All electrochemical measurements used one named workstation and one electrode specification from VidaBio Technology.
claims.oe_boundary: The result belongs to the complete hardware-chemistry-model stack; cross-hardware transfer is untested.

claims.value: 1.0 mL sample plus 1.0 mL 0.6 mM KOH, reacted for 3 hours at room temperature.
claims.supporting_paraphrase: The butyrate route used alkaline dissociation under the reported sample, reagent, time, and temperature conditions.
claims.oe_boundary: The reported condition requires direct reproduction; it is not an interchangeable generic pretreatment.

claims.value: The final dissociation route used CV; 200 uL of prepared sample was placed on a single-use electrode, each sample was measured in triplicate with fresh electrodes, and only the first scan per chip was used.
claims.source_location: Section 2.6, Electrochemical Protocols and Feature Extraction
claims.supporting_paraphrase: Fresh single-use chips and triplicate measurements were part of the published acquisition workflow.
claims.oe_boundary: Electrode-lot, day, and operator robustness remain transfer questions.

value.relationship: independent test cohort within the same source study

claims.supporting_paraphrase: Thirty fecal samples not used for model tuning were compared with GC-MS within the study.
claims.oe_boundary: This is not independent external replication or OE validation.

claims.supporting_paraphrase: For butyrate in the 30-sample fecal test cohort, ANN predictions were compared with GC-MS and produced the reported error and fit metrics.
claims.oe_boundary: Source-study performance does not establish transfer to another laboratory, instrument, electrode lot, cohort, or preprocessing implementation.

claims.supporting_paraphrase: The internal model-development test split reports different butyrate metrics from the independent fecal cohort.
claims.oe_boundary: Do not substitute these internal metrics for the 30-sample fecal test-cohort result.

claims.supporting_paraphrase: Twenty-four of 30 butyrate results were reported within plus or minus five percent of the GC-MS reference.
claims.oe_boundary: Relative error can be unstable at low concentrations; use the full method-comparison statistics.

claims.source_location: Section 3.3, Figure S5, and Table S3
claims.supporting_paraphrase: Butyrate showed a small negative bias that was statistically different from zero, with the reported limits of agreement.
claims.oe_boundary: The bias must be included when judging replication; high R-squared alone is insufficient.

claims.value: Study data are not public because of privacy and ethics restrictions; de-identified supporting data may be requested from the corresponding author subject to institutional approval.
claims.supporting_paraphrase: A reusable public data package is not linked by the article.
claims.oe_boundary: Reproduction depends on an author request or a ground-up implementation.

claims.value: C.-H. T. was an employee of Germark Biotechnology Co., Ltd.; the article states that the company had no role in the study or publication decision.
claims.supporting_paraphrase: The employment disclosure and the authors' no-role statement are both retained.
claims.oe_boundary: Disclosure is context, not evidence that the method is invalid or independently replicated.

claims.source_location: Git history and reachable COMP-038 artifacts
claims.supporting_paraphrase: No July 14 full-text retrieval or verification artifact exists; the addendum was authored on July 15.
claims.oe_boundary: The present artifact is newly dated and must not be backdated.

claims.supporting_paraphrase: Gu was read in full text; De Baere was verified only at primary-abstract scope.

result.reason: The source read supports two matrix-specific transfer candidates but no ready-to-adopt OE assay.
result.culture_supernatant: De Baere HPLC-UV remains a Tier 3 method-transfer candidate; paired spike/recovery and GC-MS comparison are required in one exact OE matrix.
result.stool: Gu electrochemical/ANN remains a Tier 2 candidate; complete-stack reproduction and independent external transfer are required.
